$comment: Re-based to 2.0.0 at cutover. The seeded 1.46.2 was the yschimke/compose-ai-tools release these
modules were extracted from; carrying it forward would have implied a lineage this repository
does not have, and re-basing DOWN (to 1.0.0, say) would rank below the 1.4x artifacts already on
Central and make `latest` resolve to the stale upstream-built ones. See docs/VERSIONING.md.
Versions here are INDEPENDENT of compose-ai-tools. That repository consumes these coordinates
at the version its gradle/libs.versions.toml pins; it no longer builds these modules.
